messages:
maya_marketing: Quick kickoff — we need a one-pager (single-sheet) solution brief targeted at enterprise buyers that covers security, SLAs, and deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Purpose: webinar handout, inbound routing asset, and an attachable field packet. Need a wire draft by EOD Wed. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/draft/1aBcD (placeholder)

alex_product: Good. Who's the primary persona? CISO / platform lead / infra buyer? That will determine tone (exec vs technical).

maya_marketing: Primary: CISO for procurement + platform leads for technical appendix. Two micro-variations on the same sheet: top half exec-friendly, bottom half quick technical callouts. One CTA for demo + SLA conversation.

jordan_sales: For routing: if they request SLA details or private deploy -> sales-assisted (AE + solutions eng). If they ask only about hosted pricing or benchmarks -> self-serve nurture. Can we add a short qualifying checkbox on the sheet? e.g., "I need: [ ] SOC2/PXI compliance [ ] Private VPC [ ] Dedicated capacity"

priya_solutions: Love the checkbox idea. Suggested hero bullets to include (short, measurable):
- P99 latency: <120ms for chat workloads (typical prod config)
- Throughput: 300 tokens/s per GPU pod (example)
- Unit-cost delta vs naive self-host: ~40% savings with Redwood Optimize suggestions
- Security: KMS/HSM integrations, VPC peering support, audit log streaming to SIEM
- Rollout/ops: canary + A/B + automatic fallback to lighter models for capacity events

sam_engineering: Adding a tiny benchmark snippet we can paste into the brief (feel free to edit):
```
Example benchmark (chat-16k seq):
- Model: open-llama-13b-quant
- Config: ded. pool, 8x A100, batching = auto
- Median latency: 85ms
- P99 latency: 118ms
- Cost per 1M tokens: $42 (after batching/cache)
```

maya_marketing: This is great. Tone: keep bullets punchy, avoid jargon in top half. Include a micro-infographic: three columns for Deploy Modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with 2-3 checkbox items each (speed, predictability, compliance). Who can sketch copy for that column content?

priya_solutions: I'll draft the column copy. Quick proposals:
- Hosted: Fastest time-to-value, public catalog, usage billing
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed throughput, private data tenancy
- Private: VPC/on-prem, customer-managed KMS, audit & compliance exports

jordan_sales: CTA language suggestion: "Schedule a 20-min SLA review + technical fit" (link to booking); routing rules: if "Private" or "Dedicated" checked -> route to Solutions (priya) + AE; else -> self-serve demo funnel.

maya_marketing: Need final copy + 1-paragraph "how it works" technical blurb for the bottom that platform engs can hand to infra teams. Priya, can you do that? Also need a 2-line executive lead that Dave (field comms) can use in the webinar slide deck.

priya_solutions: On it. Draft will include a 3-sentence "how it works" and a 2-line exec blurb. Will drop in the doc by tomorrow morning.

sam_engineering: Minor ask: add one single-line note about graceful degradation / fallbacks so we can avoid "downtime" questions. e.g., "Automatic fallback to compatible model variants to preserve availability under constrained capacity." Keep it short.

maya_marketing: Perfect. Owners: priya_solutions = draft copy + checkboxes + technical blurb; sam_engineering = benchmark table and fallback line; alex_product = final technical accuracy check; jordan_sales = routing + CTA; maya_marketing = final copy + design handoff to design.

deploy-bot: Document created: https://drive.internal/redwood/marketing/enterprise-slas-onepager-draft (placeholder). Assigned: priya_solutions, sam_engineering. Due: 2024-05-01 EOD.

jordan_sales: Also recommend a one-sentence FAQ entry for sales: "When to push Dedicated vs Private?" -> Dedicated = predictable throughput and isolation; Private = regulatory/air-gapped needs.

maya_marketing: Agree. Let's keep thread focused on copy/metrics. If anyone has objections to the benchmark numbers or wording, flag here. Otherwise I'll assemble the one-pager layout mock and ping design.

priya_solutions: No objections from me. I'll add SOC2 + ISO info and quick KMS note.

sam_engineering: Fine by me.

maya_marketing: Thanks all — I'll post a short layout mock by noon tomorrow. :thumbsup:
